note: Security Overhaul SKSE - Lock Add-ons v0.1.9.1. FOMOD required files are meshes/ and Addons_LID.ini; the only choice is the texture resolution group, taken at 2k (locks are small clutter, 1024 cap). Asset-only add-on: no SKSE DLL and no plugin, so no runtime group. RETIERED 2026-09-06 from 1k to 2k after the user's texture-policy directive ("treat the texture limits less as limits and more as ideal. The lockpicking interface is pretty large so having high res locksmithing is normal"): these assets are drawn at high screen coverage in the lockpicking view, so the small-clutter default does not fit them. 2048 stays under the 4096 hard ceiling. 4k was not taken - it is 22 MB per map against 5.5 MB at 2k, and 2k is what the surveyed lists that tag a tier (Nolvus) use.
